name: Night Stalker raises critical strike chance 3 and 6 percent (#1769)
contract: Night Stalker 300792 (rank 1) and 300793 (rank 2) are SpellFamily 21 passives. Effect 0 is an inert dummy (effect 3, BasePoints -1, no aura). Effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT (290), BasePoints 2 / 5 with DieSides 1 = +3 / +6 percent. AuraEffect::HandleAuraModCritPct (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:4892) recalculates the weapon-dependent crit fields (Player::UpdateWeaponDependentCritAuras, Player.cpp:7354, which sums SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT into the base flat crit) and every spell school's crit field (Player::UpdateSpellCritChance sums SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT, StatSystem.cpp:981), which is what the tooltip 'increases your critical strike chance by 3/6 percent' promises. The scenario snapshots PLAYER_CRIT_PERCENTAGE and the Shadow spell crit field before, then asserts the exact delta for each rank; the rank 1 passive is unlearned before rank 2 so the two never overlap.
